messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Metformin is prescribed particularly for those with fertility difficulties.
Metformin is backed by extensive research.
Metformin is backed by clinical guidelines.
Metformin helps regulate cycles.
Metformin supports ovulation.
Metformin may help reduce androgen-related symptoms.
Androgen-related symptoms include acne.
Androgen-related symptoms include excess hair growth.
Metformin can aid with weight management.
This weight management aid is for those affected by PCOS-related weight gain.
Triplet: ["Metformin", "prescribed for", "fertility difficulties"]

The relation 'prescribed for' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject entity is medically prescribed or recommended for the object entity, which is a condition or health issue.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'applies to': The subject entity is applicable to the group of patients or conditions specified by the object entity.
B. 'related to': The subject drug is associated with the medical condition or disease specified by the object entity.
C. 'known as': The subject medical condition is also referred to by the name specified by the object entity.
D. 'have': The subject group of patients has the medical condition or characteristic specified by the object entity.
E. 'treats': The subject drug is used to treat or manage the disease or medical condition specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
